# A component declared in a body calls the owner's method by bare name, and
# the compiled Go runs it (#202).
#
# Not a testdata/component_*.sngl fixture: that harness runs every platform,
# and android emits `/* unresolved method */` for a component-body method call
# from any handler, nested component or not. This asserts the shape on a
# Go-backed target, where the call resolves.

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

component main node {
    var count = 2
    var seen = -1

    func bump() { count = count + 10 }

    component readout() node {
        effect(@mount {
            seen = count
            bump()
        })

        text(value="{count}")
    }

    readout()
    text(value="{count}:{seen}")
}

func testNestedBodyCallsTheOwnersMethod(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.seen == 2)
    t.assert(c.count == 12)
}

window {
    main
}
-- testrun/bubbletea/go/app.sngl/main/1 --
sha256:34e1df92ad283cf76bc2ea72c7c10c82
{
  "results": [
    {
      "Desc": "NestedBodyCallsTheOwnersMethod",
      "Passed": true
    }
  ]
}
